name: kepler
description: Plan and dispatch context-aware engineering work across existing Codex projects, with structured results and scoped memory.

interface.longDescription: Creates a Kepler control project with a confirmed architecture map, revisioned Plans, budgeted ContextPacks, exact one-shot worker dispatch, structured WorkerResults, scoped memory, read-only Doctor checks, and focused engineering workflows while keeping repositories and workers in normal Codex projects.
defaultPrompt: /kepler setup: connect my existing Codex projects and propose an architecture map.
/kepler plan: turn this engineering outcome into a revisioned cross-domain Plan.
/kepler status: show workers, evidence, blockers, and newly ready units.
